critique.evidence: Desktop has a strong editorial headline, disciplined dark palette, and clear cyan/red semantic accents. Tablet and mobile lose that polish: the card becomes excessively tall, the red artifact panel is cramped and visually noisy, faint background content collides with foreground text, and small mono labels strain readability. The mobile header drops the brand and exposes only a clipped nav fragment with an ambiguous “SWIPE →” cue; tablet also shows clipped/ghosted navigation content. Hierarchy remains recognizable, but spacing, density, and responsive composition are not consistently demo-ready.
critique.fix: Redesign tablet/mobile as a deliberate single-column layout: remove or further suppress background content beneath the red overlay, increase small-text size/contrast, reduce nested borders and vertical padding, and prevent awkward line wrapping in the artifact details. Give the header a clean compact identity plus an explicit menu or polished scroll affordance, with no clipped or ghosted items.
